answer_1.quote: Recent advances in Natural Language Generation (NLG) have significantly enhanced the development of summarization systems.

answer_2.quote: We consider several reference-based metrics, chosen to balance popularity and diversity.

answer_4.quote: We hired three Master's students in Computational Linguistics and tasked them to evaluate four LLM outputs ( §3.2) and five human references ( §3.1), following Fabbri et al. ( )'s criteria.
answer_4.guideline: assess summaries based on four criteria: coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance, using a Likert scale of 1-5
